_note: Held Item catalog — all 32 of docs/design/catalogs/held-items.md. One slot per Pokémon, always on, wearer-only, swapped only in the Map View and kept until the run ends (§7.4.1). Releasing a Pokémon drops its item back to the bag rather than losing it. Type-boost items (+20 % wearer-only, §7.4.2), Type Plates (+5 % Lead Aura for the bench, §7.4.3), sustain/defence (§7.4.4), tempo (§7.4.5) and signatures (§7.4.6). `thick-club` is locked to Marowak and never enters a random pool.
